x: The 1937 race was run over a shortened course and the times are therefore not relevant but the 'Belgravian' congratulated Ted Stimpson "for his fine stylish run" and W E Lucas, "who won the handicap in splendid fashion." Both men were of course destined for International honours.
880 yds L W Herbert, A A Bird reserves T H Scrimshaw, W E Lucas, F H C White. 2 Mile Scratch team L J Cohen, J Parker, A W Penny, C T Carter, D Patience, J Ginty, E S Stimpson, H W Shields.
